about: Design values used by the v15 landing, try-on and pricing designs, mapped to the tokens that already exist in apps/web-next/app/globals.css. Use the existing token wherever one is named; the few extras are listed with a suggested name.

ink.use: text, primary buttons, dark tiles, active states

second.use: meters track, dividers, inactive discs, menu icon tiles

studio.use: image wells behind garments and photos, small icon tiles

opsSheet.note: The AI operations scene is dark in both themes. Scope token overrides to it (the way .gc-auth-brand does) so cards, borders and text inside it use cream-on-ink values in light theme too.

color.darkNote: Dark values for the new tokens are suggestions tuned against the existing dark palette (background #090807, card #12100e, border #262321, muted text #9d9790). Check contrast with the axe spec in dark as well.

font.rules: Arabic never gets letter-spacing or uppercase (already enforced by the :lang(ar) rule). Digits stay Western (latn) in both languages, matching the current pricing formatter.

type.pageH1: try-on 44px desktop / 30px phone; pricing 50px desktop / 32px phone
type.sectionH2: pricing section headings 40px desktop / 28px phone. Use the golden scale text-[28px] sm:text-4xl lg:text-[44px].
type.small: 12 to 13.5px for captions, chips and meters
type.weights: 700 for headings and buttons, 600 for nav and chips, 400 to 500 for body
type.sceneHeading: landing scene headings 48px desktop, tracking -0.035em; phone 28 to 32px (see the phone board). Within 4px of the golden 44px step, so the golden scale may be used on desktop.

shadow.header: desktop 0 10px 30px -22px rgba(32, 29, 27, 0.4); phone the same at 0.45
shadow.note: The existing --gc-landing-shadow is close to the card shadow and can replace it.

size.touchTarget: 44px minimum, 48px for primary buttons on phones
size.headerDesktop: fixed pill, top 18px, height 62px, width min(1240px, 100% - 40px), backdrop blur 12px, background card at 86% opacity, shadow 0 10px 30px -22px ink at 40%
size.headerPhone: fixed pill, 12px from the edges, height 58px, background card at 90% opacity, shadow 0 10px 30px -22px ink at 45%; below 360px wide hide the GRINDCTRL wordmark and keep the mark

motion.durations: 0.3s small state changes, 0.45 to 0.6s card and caption changes, 0.8 to 0.95s image reveals and pointer glides
motion.reducedMotion: no movement, no loops and no scroll pacing: every state shows its end frame and the landing story renders as stacked sections. Short opacity and colour transitions may stay, as app/globals.motion.test.ts requires.
motion.globalTransitionNote: globals.css applies a 220ms colour and box-shadow transition broadly; opt the story elements that the director writes every frame out of it.

breakpoints.prototype: landing story switches phone to desktop at 1000px; try-on and pricing at 900px
breakpoints.production: One switch point for layout: below lg (1024px) the phone layouts, centred in a column no wider than 560px; from lg the desktop layouts inside mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8, never CSS zoom. Pricing plans: one column below lg, two by two from lg to xl, four columns from xl (1280px). Try-on studio: piece and photo columns 260px with 48px joiners from lg to xl, 300px and 56px from xl. Landing story on tablets: fit and spread use the 560px column width, not the viewport. Viewports shorter than 560px (phones in landscape) render the story as stacked sections, like reduced motion.
